desc: Iteration 1 structural review of Tilly March synopsis against bible §4.6/§9.1 and the approved synopsis judge criteria.

items.name: Framework and wound scope
items.evidence: Synopsis S-2 places the Honneth framework inside :::secret, S-3 maps its movement across three acts, and S-4-2 explicitly limits this season to pillar B plus partial pillar A, matching the stated Tilly route scope.

items.name: Thread and act architecture
items.evidence: S-4-1 separates main, inner, Fixer relationship, NPC, and external-pressure threads; it gives causal chains, per-thread scope, collision summary, and the judgment-error to record-generation climax. S-3 provides three distinct questions and Fixer states.

items.name: Buildup and Fixer design
items.evidence: S-4-4 gives distinguishable asynchronous wound/emotion/event/narrative/Fixer trajectories and a concrete convergence point; S-4-6 defines companionable intervention, one judgment-error, and the Tilly-specific physical marker of changing luggage tags.

items.name: Route and hard-rule compliance
items.evidence: The synopsis preserves Tilly's four-stage route and does not confirm T3 or identify Isen as the old proctor; the proctor remains an unresolved '청회색 제복, 그 사람' hook. No banned names are present in the reviewed synopsis files.

items.name: Catharsis and sidecar declaration
items.evidence: synopsis.json contains top-level desc plus synopsisDesign.catharsis and fixerDesign with the required axis arrays, rationale, attitude, imperfection, and shiftNarration; stage slots and C-05/C-06 handoff match the slot master.
